entities.summary: Kevin Peter Hall was an American actor. Hall stood 7 ft 2 in (2.18 m) tall, and frequently played monster characters. He was the original title monster in the science fiction Predator franchise, appearing in the first 1987 film and its 1990 sequel. Hall also portrayed the eponymous Harry in the fantasy comedy film Harry and the Hendersons (1987), a role he reprised for the first season of the syndicated television adaptation (1990–1991). His human roles included Dr. Elvin "El" Lincoln on the NBC science fiction series Misfits of Science (1985–1986) and Warren Merriwether on the sitcom 227 (1989–1990).

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: As a prominent actor in the 1980s and 1990s, Kevin Peter Hall's roles in films like Harry and the Hendersons and Predator contributed to the popularization of monster characters in mainstream cinema. His tall stature and physical presence helped redefine the on-screen portrayal of these creatures.
